spans.text: You bid someone farewell, as usual.
You then meet her again, as usual.
Disconnect from a call with her, as usual. Then, wait for her to reconnect, as usual.
Repeating it over and over, you take it all for granted.
...Until one day, you finally realize...
M...16... Why are you here...!?
It seems like Persica wasn't lying. You really have changed.
Every meeting that you've had, every parting that you've experienced...
...Those are the final gifts that fate has seen fit to grant you.
M16... your appearance...
What happened to you...?!
What happened to me?
I was captured and tortured by Sangvis Ferri. Surprised?
How?! How...?!
M16... how could this ever happen to you?!
Many things aren't as they seem.
I'm still helping you, just in a different fashion.
First AR-15...now even you...
Persica will surely be able to save you...
So...M16...I won't give up the chance to bring you home this time!
That time has not yet arrived, M4.
There's still... something... that I must see through.
For something you must see through?!
What are you even doing this for?!
For you, and for the future of us all.
Um...
Hush!
In that case, why won't you believe us?!
You don't have to face this alone...
(Sighs) People are like trees. The higher the branches grow toward the bright sky, the further the roots must stretch into the murky depths.
I'm your leader and your friend.
There isn't any problem that we can't solve together...
We've already overcome so many obstacles... Surely this time, we can also...
You just have to trust us...
I...I trust...
...Wait, at this rate, Miss M16 is gonna be convinced!
Oh... you're right...
I know!
How about this?
I'm your leader and your friend.
There isn't any problem that we can't solve together...
We've already overcome so many obstacles... Surely this time, we can also...
It's not like I don't trust you!
Ugh, but there really are lots of stuff that I just can't tell you!
Huh...?
Gosh, you're so dumb! I'll be back soon, okay?!
Uh...
I don't think...
Uh...Miss M16 would ever talk like this...
Oh? Really?
But with that, everything is solved!
I-I also agree it isn't likely that Miss M16 would ever talk to Miss M4 in that tone...
Exactly. Miss T91 will notice this isn't like the M16 that she knows once she gets to this part.
Our main objective is to fool her!
Argh...! This is such a pain! Then what the hell should we even change it to?!
I give up. T77, go get me a drink.
Hey! I'm telling you to buy me a drink, not rewrite the script!
...It's so much trouble communicating with you.
I'll get you your usual drink.
..."I'm doing this precisely because I trust you."
That's more like it...
Yeah... I can totally imagine Miss M16 saying that...
How come you're all okay with T77's suggestion?!
Because...it makes more sense...
You're all bullying me! From now on I'm through with you!
If you're through with us now, we won't be able to make the video.
Ugh...
T77 only proposed the change for Miss T91.
Isn't that also the reason why you've been working so hard all this time, Miss T65?
Fine...
We're going through so much trouble all because Miss M16 suddenly went missing!
This is all her fault!
...Miss T65, it's no use thinking about this now.
Maybe someone'll come along and tell us...
...that all of this is just part of some show...
But even the Commander told us...
This is Miss M16 though! There must be some kind of misunderstanding!
She was just retrieving some document! What could Sangvis Ferri do to her?!
I know, she probably just got lost on her way back!
If only that were true...
I also hope the Commander would tell us everything that happened in the last few weeks were all lies.
But up till now, both the Commander and RO have been avoiding the subject...
Maybe...something unimaginable...really happened to her...
Humph! In any case, I refuse to believe S.F. is that powerful!
This is the amazing Miss M16 we're talking about!
It's Miss M16...
You're right, something must be holding her up. She will be back.
But even if we keep waiting...
When T77 came back yesterday for a visit, she said...
Your apple soda.
Oh, thanks!
Alright, I forgive you for rewriting the script!
...T77 gesticulates.
You'd better say that out loud. We might misinterpret...if you sign everything...
I've put T91's bubble tea on her desk.
The desk is so full I can't put any more bubble tea there.
She still... hasn't drank any of them at all?
T77 shakes her head.
She doesn't even have the strength to argue with the Commander that Miss M16 hasn't gone missing...
It's been so long since we lost track of Miss M16.
Could T91's neural cloud have suffered a meltdown already?
That's what worries me the most.
According to T77...we can't let T91's mental state worsen any further...
If she hasn't had a meltdown already, she's on the brink of one.
Huh? H-How could it be that serious...?!
I haven't seen her for a few days, but I thought it was only because she was in maintenance...
It did start off with maintenance...
But as time went by, her situation deteriorated...
How did it come to this...?
Isn't there anything Miss Persica and the Commander can do?
...That little girl probably admires that missing person more than any of us ever will...
I suggested to the Commander that we should wipe all memories concerning M16 from T91's neural cloud... but the Commander vehemently refused.
If T91 ever found out you proposed such a thing, she'd hate you forever.
She could hate me for all she wants, humph.
I'd rather she have the strength to even hate me in the first place. It'd be better than how she is now.
But the Commander came up with a much better idea than directly tampering with Miss T91's memory.
As long as... it goes smoothly...
This is why we're all here!
With so many of us, it should be a piece of cake filming this short video!
Even if we want to get T91 to pull herself together...
Will this actually work? We're just coming up with a lie to deceive her.
What we're doing is no different than shining a light at the rooftop of the opposite building and asking a desperate person to walk over by stepping on the ray of light.
To someone with nowhere else to go, that ray of light is pretty much their future.
All we're trying to do is give her hope that "Miss M16 will come home soon"...
It will be Miss M16 herself doing the talking; T91 shouldn't notice anything wrong with it.
But what if Miss M16 really won't be coming back?
Or what if... she comes back as a different person? What then?
As if... that would ever happen!
Say something, M3, Garand!
If Miss M16 really is gone for good, then M4, T91...and the others...
If the Commander and everyone else in the AR Team all believe in Miss M16, we shouldn't get carried away thinking about such nonsense.
No matter what the future is like, we should focus on what's right before us.
That's right! That's exactly right!
If you're this optimistic...
Well then, let's hope the filming later goes smoothly.
Huh? Later?
Didn't the Commander arrange it to be in the small hours tomorrow?
Doesn't that mean after midnight tonight?
Huh?
Whaaaaaaat??
M-Miss Garand...
...That seems to be the case.
I thought we took so long to prep because we had plenty of time...
Uh-oh, we're done for.
Ahem... If we didn't spend enough time making preparations, we'd have to waste a lot more effort trying to catch up later on.
Still, don't worry too much. All that's left to do is something that can be easily handled.
Everything we need is already in the script. What could go wrong?
Humph! It's just carrying a camera around filming stuff!
T77, let's go!
Though everything we need is already in the script...
Things never really go according to a script in reality, do they?
Brrr... It's freezing...
Are we there yet? Do we really need to travel so far...?
This is it.
But keep your voice down. There's still some leftover S.F. wandering around.
Huh? We're filming with real S.F.?!
Isn't that too dangerous?!
CGI effects take too much time to make... Filming on site is the easiest for us.
We can receive support from the base anytime in this area. This is what we've decided after discussing with the Commander.
Miss M3, please go and put on some makeup. We'll return once we have all the shots we need.
I... I understand.
...First off, we need a battle scene of us exchanging fire with Sangvis Ferri, right?
Scout, strike, ambush, sweep... I've carried out all these missions before, but never once carrying a camera.
It's good to experience new things!
S.F., S.F., where are you...? Let us get a nice shot of your face—
Sigh... Do we really have to go this far just to forge something?
There's only a thin line that separates illusion and hope.
If we can grant someone in despair the courage to move forward and face the future, even reality will have no choice but to bend to our whims.
Do we... really have what it takes...?
